title: TypeScript retry with exponential backoff
context: retry(fn, opts) calls fn up to opts.attempts times in total (attempts >= 1). Between attempt n and n+1 it waits baseMs * 2^(n-1), capped at maxMs, so the first wait is baseMs. Errors for which isRetryable returns false are rethrown at once; when every attempt fails, the last error is thrown.
